spec.situation_desc: had a loan application declined with no explanation

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Good morning, Thistle Bank, Zara speaking. How can I help?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Hi, I’m Oskar Fitzgerald. My loan application’s been declined and nobody’s explained why. I’m really unhappy about it.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’m sorry you’ve been left without an explanation, Oskar. I’ll do what I can to help. Before I discuss the application, could I check your full name and date of birth, please?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thank you. And the first line of your address?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thanks, that’s verified. I can see the decision was made on Tuesday. I appreciate how frustrating it is not to know more.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: It’s not good enough. I’ve been a customer for years and just got a rejection with no reason.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I understand why you’re upset. I’m logging this as a complaint about the decline and the lack of explanation.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’ll take ownership of it. I’ll send the complaint to our lending review team today and ask them to look at the decision and what explanation we can provide.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: And when will I hear something?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: You’ll hear back from us within 5 working days. I’ll also make sure the team has your preferred contact number ending 4821.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’ll request a call from the lending review team, and I’ll check that your complaint has been passed on today. I can’t promise what their review will conclude, but I’ll make sure it’s followed up.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: All right. I expect a proper explanation this time.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: That’s understandable, Oskar. I’ve recorded that you want a clear explanation of the decision, and the team will contact you within 5 working days.
